text:
tyler: FYI restore of prod-db snapshot taken 2027-03-10 failed during decrypt step. KMS error: DecryptError (4001). Happened at 02:14 UTC. Anyone oncall?
encops-bot: Alert: snapshot-restore FAILED for snapshot prod-db-20270310. Error: KMS.DecryptError. Incident ID: enc-2800123456.
marta: @tyler thanks — quick Q: was this snapshot encrypted with customer CMK (CMEK) or our service key?
tyler: CMEK (customer-managed key) — customer-tenant-42. We rotated the CMK at ~00:05 UTC (routine rotation) and snapshot at 01:58 UTC.
lee: hmm the rotation window lines up. Can you paste the audit line for the KMS grant or the key policy entry?
tyler: logs show: "kms:GenerateDataKey failed for backup-service-account: AccessDenied" and the snapshot metadata indicates encrypted=true, key_id=arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd-tenant-42
ajay: yesterday we merged an RBAC cleanup that removed a handful of service principals from the backup role to tighten scope. possible we removed backup-service-account's kms:Decrypt on the CMK.
marta: if that's true this is an RBAC regression causing restores to fail after rotation because the new key material requires explicit grants. need triage steps.
lee: immediate triage: 1) verify key policy allows backup-service-account or backup-service-role to use kms:Decrypt 2) check key grants for that principal 3) check cloudtrail for kms:CreateGrant events -> did rotation create new grants?
tyler: I pulled cloudtrail: no CreateGrant recorded around rotation. only a few kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion (irrelevant) and UpdateKeyDescription. No grant events.
ajay: likely cause: our RBAC cleanup removed role entries so kms CreateGrant never executed on rotation. fallback behavior: restore path expects grant-based decrypt for rewrapped data keys.
marta: can we do a one-off manual grant so restore can proceed? risk/caveats?
ajay: yes we can create a grant quickly:
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd-tenant-42
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/backup-service-role
  --operations Decrypt Encrypt ReEncryptFrom ReEncryptTo GenerateDataKey
```
This gives the role Decrypt rights for the lifetime of the grant. Must record GrantId for cleanup.
lee: long term we want key policy + rotation hook that re-creates grants for our backup service when we rotate CMKs. Also add test coverage in staging to simulate rotation+restore.
tyler: doing manual grant now. will post GrantId.
tyler: GrantId: 8a4f-... created at 02:28 UTC. triggered restore, decrypt succeeded, restore proceeding. :lock:
marta: ok priority: 1) patch RBAC cleanup revert for backup-service-role kms:Decrypt 2) add CI test for rotation+restore 3) update runbook to include CreateGrant step and owner
ajay: notes on playbook edits: include detection query for missing grants — CloudTrail query:
```
lookup cloudtrail where eventName="CreateGrant" and requestParameters.keyId = "arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd-tenant-42" | stats count() by eventTime
```
and alert if zero CreateGrant events within 10m of rotation.
lee: also add automation: rotation Lambda should attempt up to 3 retry CreateGrant calls and escalate to encops if fails.
tyler: I'll open a PR to revert the RBAC change and add explicit kms:Decrypt in the role policy.
marta: assign: @tyler do the RBAC revert + PR, @lee add rotation->grant automation, @ajay add CI test + cloudtrail alert rule. I'll follow up with customer comms template.
ajay: quick vuln triage note: this is not a cryptographic vuln, it's a permissions/regression. severity: P2 (customer impact but quick mitigation).
tyler: customer notified via support ticket #SUP-8241, linked to incident enc-2800123456.
encops-bot: Incident enc-2800123456 status: mitigated -> restore succeeded after manual grant. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/encops/key-rotation-restore
marta: add postmortem checklist item: review rotation schedule + dev windows to avoid coincident RBAC changes.
tyler: got it. will include timeline and commands used in the incident notes.
marta: thanks team. closing slack triage thread after PRs land. (reaction: :white_check_mark: by marta)
